authority: Derived strict-graphical migration registry. It does not replace the catalog, current-model map, formal-harness map, or MWORKS runtime evidence.

migration_policy.strict_completion_rule: A route becomes complete only after a strict core or explicit exception, a nonblank whole-aircraft graphical entry, SG-0 through SG-4 records, and current model/parameter/scenario evidence are present.

schemes.claim_boundary: The current Golden PID graph reuses a text-backed Modelica controller base. A native Sysblock compiles alone, but MWORKS cannot flatten its ports into the shared Modelica plant, so no strict whole-aircraft claim is allowed.
